senses.gloss: ohana, nt. (cf. Skt. ūhati, ūha, change, derangement, etc.? or Pali ūhanati disturbs?), acc. to Tib. the making deluded or disturbed: Mvy 〔4371〕 ˚nam = Tib. ḥkhrul byed, or ḥkhrug byed.

ohāra (m.; perh. cf. AMg. oharai, establish, settle, ‘sthāpan karnā, pratiṣṭhit karnā’; derived by Ratnach. from upa-har-), domicile, abode: Mv 〔iii.36.19〕 te … svakam [] ohāraṃ gatā; 〔37.3〕 tato ohārāto (mss. ˚rito) nirgamya; 〔40.1〕. ohāraṃ prasthito.
